Frequently Asked Questions

Are there any contracts or commitments?

No, there are no contracts or commitments. With SocialPilot, you can cancel your account anytime – irrespective of the plan you’ve chosen.

What payment options do you offer?

When using SocialPilot, you’ll be required to pay in US dollars. We accept payments made with credit cards and PayPal.

Can I change my plan later?

Yes, you can switch your plans or downgrade/upgrade your subscription anytime you want. You can also Pause your subscription if you don’t need your account for a certain time period.

What kind of support do you offer?

SocialPilot provides you with reliable customer support across different channels – mail, chat, mobile app and call (scheduled as per your convenience).

Can users under the Ultimate plan in SocialPilot use Slack integration?

SocialPilot users under any plan, including the Ultimate plan can integrate their Slack workspaces into the SocialPilot accounts. But people who are using white label solutions will not be able to use Slack integration with SocialPilot. Using white label changes the user experience of SocialPilot, replacing the logo of the tool with the user’s brand. But such customization is not possible on Slack. Hence to preserve the customized branding experience of white label features, Slack integrations for these users have been made unavailable.

Some More Clarity for Better Decisions 2

Is there a free trial?

Yes, there is a free 100-credit trial available to test out the platform.

Can I manage reviews for more than 3 locations?

Yes, you can add more locations at $10/location per month.

What happens if I need more than 5,000 credits per month?

You can purchase additional email credits in bundles of 1,000 credits for $10 per bundle.

What happens when I run out of credits?

You can enable an auto-replenishment option to automatically purchase additional credit bundles when you’re running low.

Can I send SMS review requests?

Yes, you can send SMS/text review requests via Twilio.
